title: Support after an additional query
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let a path on $n$ binary coordinates have a partial assignment of bits. If the path is extended by assigning any bit value at coordinate $i$, then a coordinate $j$ belongs to the resulting support if and only if $j=i$ or $j$ belonged to the original support.
